`fopen()` already resolves a compress URL assembled at run time — `emit_dynamic_compress_wrapper_fopen`
does exactly that — but the byte readers only ever resolved a compile-time LITERAL. So the two
spellings of the same read disagreed: `fopen` on a concatenated compress URL decompressed, while
`file_get_contents` on the identical string answered `Failed to open stream: No such file or
directory`, naming a path no file has.
